boards.title: Your First Weekend at Hillsdale College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence built around named campus landmarks, study spaces, arts, recreation, and scheduled college activities.

cards.title: Get oriented at Central Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus landmark
cards.notes: Use the campus map to place Central Hall in relation to the Quad, library, science buildings, and Student Union before you make plans elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the campus’s central historic landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College’s campus map identifies Central Hall as a named main-campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current campus map and parking guidance before visiting by car.

cards.title: Settle in at Mossey Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · library stop
cards.notes: Take a quiet pass through the library, then choose a table or ask staff how to locate course materials and library services for the term.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library with general and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s illustrated campus map states that Mossey Library contains nearly 300,000 volumes and rare and special collections.
cards.access_notes: Library access and service availability can vary; check with library staff or the library site.

cards.entity_name: William L. and Berniece E. Grewcock Student Union
cards.title: Find the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus gathering point
cards.notes: Walk through the Student Union to locate the dining room, café, bookstore, mail center, and the Student Activities Office area for future reference.
cards.short_summary: A practical first-stop for key student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The illustrated campus map says Grewcock Student Union includes the Knorr Family Dining Room, A.J.’s Café 1844, bookstore, and student mail center.
cards.access_notes: Dining and retail purchases may be required; verify current operating details locally.

cards.title: Check the Student Activities Board calendar
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · recurring campus activity
cards.notes: See whether SAB has a current social event, then attend only the activity and location confirmed by its official listing or campus communication.
cards.short_summary: A student group that plans campus events each semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale’s Student Activities Office says the Student Activities Board plans and executes events of different sizes each semester.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Office — Student Life at Hillsdale
cards.access_notes: Events, locations, eligibility, and any costs vary; use the official current event listing.

cards.title: Take a daylight walk in Slayton Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · outdoor campus stop
cards.notes: Start at the named arboretum area and follow its trails and mapped features in daylight; pause at the gazebo or red iron bridge if open.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus collection of plants and trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College describes Slayton Arboretum as a living plant collection with trails, tree labeling and mapping, a gazebo, and a red iron bridge.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and observe posted trail, weather, and access conditions.

cards.title: Spot the Children’s Garden details
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · beside Slayton Arboretum
cards.notes: Continue from the arboretum to the named Children’s Garden and look for its pond, potting shed, herb garden, and Blue Ribbon Fair Garden.
cards.short_summary: A named garden destination beside the arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s illustrated campus map identifies the Children’s Garden and describes its potting shed, pond, Blue Ribbon Fair Garden, and herb garden.
cards.access_notes: Located with Barber House and the Slayton Arboretum Visitor Center on the campus map; observe posted access conditions.

cards.title: Follow the Liberty Walk statues
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · self-guided campus walk
cards.notes: Use the illustrated map’s statue labels to make a short walking route, stopping at the named figures that interest you rather than rushing the full loop.
cards.short_summary: A map-labeled group of campus statues.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College’s illustrated campus map labels the Statues of the Liberty Walk, including Abraham Lincoln and Frederick Douglass.
cards.access_notes: Use the current campus map for statue locations and remain on public campus paths.

cards.title: Look for a Daughtrey Gallery exhibit
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition information before going, then build in time to view the show and explore nearby Fine Arts Building spaces.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery that hosts professional, faculty, and student work.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s illustrated campus map says the Daughtrey Gallery hosts exhibits by professional artists, Hillsdale faculty, and students.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition dates and gallery access vary; verify the current show and building availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Campus Rec intramural or single-day event
cards.title: Try a Campus Rec activity
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · recreation activity
cards.notes: Check the current Campus Rec schedule, then sign up or join a listed intramural or single-day activity that fits your comfort level and availability.
cards.short_summary: Student-led recreation with leagues and campus-wide events.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale’s Campus Rec page says the group hosts intramural leagues and athletic events, including campus-wide competitions and evening leagues.
cards.source_title: Campus Rec — Student Life at Hillsdale
cards.access_notes: Registration, dates, venues, and participation requirements vary; use the current Campus Rec schedule.

cards.title: End with Christ Chapel on the map
cards.subtitle: Sunday · campus spiritual and performance venue
cards.notes: Check the college’s current calendar for an appropriate worship service, concert, or convocation, or simply include the chapel in a daylight campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A named campus venue for worship, concerts, and convocations.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s illustrated campus map identifies Christ Chapel as a center of campus spiritual life and a site for worship services, concerts, and College Convocations.
cards.access_notes: Service and performance schedules, entry arrangements, and access can vary; confirm through the college calendar.
